locking: Starts locked from the measured trimmed durations per the phase-3 pause map: start(L1) = 2.00; start(Ln+1) = start(Ln) + trimmed(Ln) + planned gap (F1 0.50 / F3 1.30 / F4 0.90 / F2 1.00). Content ends 53.272; 0.80 s hold; silent bridge 54.072–57.072 over bed only.

bed.source_file: files/short-wd01-token-musiconly.mp4 — the wd-01 package's own music bed (the shipped build's extracted music track), loop-extended to the programme duration
bed.relation: one scalar gain sets the bed ≈13.5 dB under the placed voice (−22.88 LUFS); continuous throughout — pauses are narration events, never bed cuts (the owner's standing rule)

assembly_chain: per-line conditioning: trimmed take → highpass 60 Hz → loudnorm to −23 LUFS (TP −2, LRA 7) → exact scalar settle (measured within ±0.01 of −23.00 on all eight stems)
uniform per-stem target gains about the −23.00 mean (all within ±0.01 dB — one relative balance for the whole programme, applied identically in structure to every line)
stems placed at the locked starts on a 48 kHz stereo track (adelay, no normalization)
bed loop-extended and mixed at its scalar gain

master: two-pass loudnorm toward −14 LUFS with a −1.4 dBTP ceiling (headroom for encoder overshoot — see the TP correction in measurements), then measured refinement passes; programme.mp3 exported at 192k from the kept master WAV

master_passes: measured refinement pass 3 (−14.45 LUFS / TP −1.40, kept)
measurements.tp_headroom_correction: SECOND CORRECTION, recorded as an event (2026-10-26): the first kept master measured TP −1.00 on its WAV, but the AAC encode in the rendered MP4 overshot to −0.80 dBTP — over the ≤ −1 ceiling on the delivered file. The master was re-cut with a −1.4 dBTP ceiling; the delivered MP4 now measures −14.47 LUFS / TP −1.28 dBTP and the phase-6 programme.mp3 measures −14.72 / −1.65 (verification.json, phase 7).

word_timings: Derived in this phase from the final takes (silence segmentation + character-weight allocation within segments) and written into the scene's PLAN before the scene was authored — the scene follows the media clock of THIS programme. scene_files: audio/index.html + audio/scene.json are the phase-4 scene files, unchanged — the PLAN was locked from this phase's measurements before authoring, and phase 4's fixes were geometry only, all inside phase 4. They are staged here as the render's input of record.
assembly_correction: CORRECTION, recorded as an event (2026-10-26): the first assembly attempt carried a placement defect — a loop-variable error delayed every stem by L8's start, stacking all eight lines at 48.03 s. The phase-7 onset probe caught it before anything shipped (silence 0–48.03 s on the voice track). The assembly was rebuilt with per-stem delays and re-verified: measured speech onsets match the locked starts (L1 2.023, L3 10.547, L4 17.064, L6 31.070, L8 48.049; L2/L5/L7 within their takes' lead-ins) and the planned gaps measure out on the track.
